name: floating-panel
title: Floating Panel
description: A draggable and resizable floating window with minimize, maximize and close controls.
usageSnippet:
<FloatingPanel defaultPosition={ x: 320, y: 160 } defaultSize={ width: 360, height: 260 }>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button ...props>Open panel</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Layers</@title>
  Panel content
</FloatingPanel>

props.name: allowOverflow
props.description: Whether the panel should be strictly contained within the boundary when dragging

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether the panel should close when the escape key is pressed

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the panel.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description:
The initial position of the panel when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the position of the panel.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: The default size of the panel

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the panel is disabled

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether the panel is draggable

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is closed.
By default, the trigger element is focused.

props.name: getAnchorPosition
props.description:
Function that returns the initial position of the panel when it is opened.
If provided, will be used instead of the default position.

props.name: getBoundaryEl
props.description:
The boundary of the panel. Useful for recalculating the boundary rect when
the it is resized.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: The snap grid for the panel

props.name: hideCloseTrigger
props.description: Hide the close button.

props.name: hideStageTriggers
props.description: Hide the minimize/maximize/restore stage buttons.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the floating panel. Useful for composition.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description:
Element to receive focus when the panel is opened.
By default, the first focusable element in the content is focused.

props.name: lockAspectRatio
props.description: Whether the panel is locked to its aspect ratio

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The maximum size of the panel

props.name: minSize
props.description: The minimum size of the panel

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the panel

props.name: persistRect
props.description: Whether the panel size and position should be preserved when it is closed

props.name: position
props.description: The controlled position of the panel

props.name: resizable
props.description: Whether the panel is resizable

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the trigger when the panel is closed.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the panel

props.name: strategy
props.description: The strategy to use for positioning

props.name: translations
props.description: The translations for the floating panel.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the panel is opened or closed

events.name: onPositionChange
events.description: Function called when the position of the panel changes via dragging

events.name: onPositionChangeEnd
events.description: Function called when the position of the panel changes via dragging ends

events.name: onSizeChange
events.description: Function called when the size of the panel changes via resizing

events.name: onSizeChangeEnd
events.description: Function called when the size of the panel changes via resizing ends

events.name: onStageChange
events.description: Function called when the stage of the panel changes

events.name: openChange
events.description: Sugar for onOpenChange — receives the plain boolean, enables `open:=state`.

events.name: positionChange
events.description: Sugar for onPositionChange — receives the plain point.

events.name: positionEndChange
events.description: Sugar for onPositionChangeEnd — receives the plain point.

events.name: sizeChange
events.description: Sugar for onSizeChange — receives the plain size.

events.name: sizeEndChange
events.description: Sugar for onSizeChangeEnd — receives the plain size.

events.name: stageChange
events.description: Sugar for onStageChange — receives the plain stage.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import FloatingPanel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/floating-panel/floating-panel.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; <@trigger|props|> <@title>Layers

Drag the header to move this panel. Grab any edge or corner to resize it. Use the header buttons to minimize, maximize or close.
examples.description: Drag the header to move the panel. Grab any edge or corner to resize it. Use the header buttons to minimize, maximize or close.

examples.title: Drag only
examples.source:
import FloatingPanel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/floating-panel/floating-panel.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; <@trigger|props|> <@title>Inspector
Width 320px
Resizable No
examples.description: Pass `resizable=false` to disable the resize handles and keep dragging.

examples.title: Size constraints
examples.description: Pass `minSize` and `maxSize` to clamp how far the panel can be resized.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import FloatingPanel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/floating-panel/floating-panel.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
open: ${String(panelOpen)} · stage: ${panelStage}
(panelStage = stage) defaultPosition={ x: 380, y: 200 } defaultSize={ width: 340, height: 220 } > <@title>Controlled panel

The button above owns this panel's open state, and the stage is mirrored back into the page.
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: an `open` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `openChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `open:=state`.
